oauthConsentTitle: Allow ChatGPT to access Workforce data?
oauthConsentDescription: Review the requested access before continuing. You can deny this request.
oauthConsentVisualTitle: You control which data you share.
oauthConsentVisualBody: The TEST connection uses your existing LiquidHR account. Employee-self tools can read your own data. Manager data requires a separate opt-in from Connections.
oauthConsentVisualPointSelf: Employee tools are limited to your own data.
oauthConsentVisualPointManager: Manager tools require a separate opt-in and current Direct Manager access, and stay within your direct team.
oauthConsentVisualPointReadOnly: The available tools can only read data.
oauthConsentDataTitle: Data categories available to this connection
oauthConsentDevelopmentPlans: Development plans: period, progress, status, and completion date.
oauthConsentDevelopmentGaps: Development gaps from your current role profile.
oauthConsentManagerTeamOverview: Names of active employees in your direct team.
oauthConsentManagerPendingWork: Open action tasks and leave requests for your direct team.
oauthConsentManagerLeaveCalendar: Approved vacation for your direct team over the next 90 days.
oauthConsentManagerDevelopmentPlans: Progress status of development plans for your direct team.
oauthConsentManagerFollowUps: Follow-up dates for your direct team, without note text.
oauthConsentManagerCapabilityMatrix: Allowed capability data for your direct team.
oauthConsentAccountRoleScope: This OAuth approval authorizes the ChatGPT connection. Employee-self tools, when available for your account, can read only your own data. This approval does not enable Manager tools. You can enable Manager access separately from Connections after sign-in; that requires your current Direct Manager role and remains limited to your tenant, HR group, administration, and direct team. LiquidHR checks access for every request; the request cannot choose an employee, team, or role. Available access can change when your LiquidHR permissions change.
oauthConsentReadOnly: This TEST connection has no write actions. ChatGPT cannot change data.
oauthConsentEmailScope: The email scope shares your account email with ChatGPT.
oauthConsentOfflineAccessScope: Offline access allows ChatGPT to refresh tokens until you revoke access.
oauthConsentInvalidRequest: This sign-in request is invalid, expired, or belongs to a different account.
oauthConsentManagerReconnectResetFailed: The existing ChatGPT connection could not be safely reset, so this request was not completed. Existing Manager access could not be checked; review it in Connections before retrying or deny this request.
oauthConsentUnsupportedClient: This request does not use the allowed ChatGPT OAuth redirect. Close this window.
oauthConsentUnsupportedScope: The request asks for scopes outside the limited TEST sign-in and cannot be approved.
oauthConsentNoEmployeeContext: No accessible Employee-self or direct Manager context was found. You can deny this request.
oauthConsentContextSelectionRequired: More than one valid context was found. This connection can only be allowed when LiquidHR can safely determine one current scope.
oauthConsentContextUnavailable: The Employee-self or direct Manager context could not be checked safely. You can deny this request and try again later.
oauthDecisionErrorTitle: Start a new connection in ChatGPT
oauthDecisionErrorDescription: LiquidHR could not safely complete the return to ChatGPT. This request has not been reopened. Close this window and start a new connection from ChatGPT.
oauthConnectionsDescription: Review which applications have access to your account. You can revoke ChatGPT TEST access here.
oauthConnectionsVisualBody: This page shows OAuth applications authorized through your own LiquidHR account.
oauthConnectionsVisualPointScope: The grant list comes from your signed-in session.
oauthConnectionsVisualPointRevoke: Revocation invalidates ChatGPT sessions and refresh tokens.
oauthConnectionsVisualPointEmployee: Employee self-service stays limited to your own data.
oauthConnectionsLoadFailed: Authorized applications could not be loaded safely. Refresh the page and try again.
oauthConnectionsConfirmDescription: ChatGPT will no longer be able to read LiquidHR data. You must authorize the connection again before using it.
oauthConnectionsRevoked: ChatGPT access was revoked and removed from your authorization list.
oauthConnectionsRevokeFailed: Access could not be revoked. Refresh the page and try again.
oauthManagerConsentDescription: This ChatGPT connection can read information about your current direct team only while you have active Direct Manager access. LiquidHR checks your current role and scope on every request. This approval is separate from Employee access and does not change OAuth scopes.
oauthManagerConsentEnabled: Manager access is enabled for this ChatGPT connection.
oauthManagerConsentUnavailable: Current connection permissions could not be verified. Manager access remains unavailable.
oauthManagerConsentConfirmTitle: Allow Manager data for this ChatGPT connection?
oauthManagerConsentConfirmDescription: If you continue, this ChatGPT connection may read the Manager categories listed above for your current direct team. LiquidHR rechecks your active role and team scope on every request. The permission is read-only and applies only to this OAuth connection.
oauthManagerConsentSuccess: Manager access was enabled for this ChatGPT connection.
oauthManagerConsentFailed: Manager access could not be enabled. Refresh the page and try again.
